svg.title: Where the website of Paperless Sync takes its look from
svg.desc: The icon of the app, img/app.svg, is copied to docs/images/app.svg, which scripts/check-project.sh compares with it; the website shows the copy as its logo, its favicon and on the preview cards of its pages. The social preview of the repository, rendered from .github/social-preview.html, is the preview card of the home page. The colors come from docs/stylesheets/brand.css, and the hook .github/mkdocs_project.py writes the versions of appinfo/info.xml into the pages. The files of the repository are green, the parts of the website blue.
